source: Experiment 1 — 'Intrinsic Branching from a Derived Lorentz Structure'
description: Independent development of the positive Euclidean starting datum, the spin factor, the derived Lorentz bilinear structure, the Clifford branch and the intrinsic Lorentz spin cover. Vendored into this repository as RequestProject/Experiment1 (152 Lean files), for provenance only.
notes: Dates and authorship are not recorded in this repository and are therefore left UNKNOWN.

description: Independent development of the null-sector algebra and the lift/descent machinery later abstracted into the generic Cech layer. Vendored as RequestProject/Experiment2, for provenance only.
Both experiment trees vendored into a single Lake project so that both build simultaneously.
Spine extraction: a single self-contained production tree RequestProject.Spine with a mechanical legacy firewall; no Spine module reaches an experiment tree.

Every module removed from the active tree is recorded with a classification (SUPERSEDED, COMPARISON_ONLY, PREMATURE, NEGATIVE_RESULT, OUT_OF_SCOPE) and is recoverable from git history. The PREMATURE class is important for the present milestone: connection- and curvature-style modules existed in the historical trees above a base that did not yet exist, and were removed rather than reused.
notes: This is why the present phase does not simply import a historical connection layer.

description: Topological qualification of the intrinsic spin cover and construction of continuous local sections by explicit algebraic inversion.
The abstract Cech lifting layer is instantiated with the native projection; native Spin transition data, kernel twists and fixed-cover rigidity are established.
The base-gluing primitive is introduced and proved to be additional information; the emergent base is reconstructed as a charted space.
The smooth gate is closed: a smooth base gluing yields a C-infinity four-manifold, with an explicit continuous-only negative control.
Genuine tangent transitions are computed for the emergent atlas and the weak solder is isolated as an additional coupling datum.
The weak solder is shown insufficient; the regular solder is defined, shown to be a bundle equivalence and shown to induce a smooth Lorentz metric of signature (1,3).
The adversarial global-topology battery: the two reconvergence gates, the Moebius-type negative control, the loop lift-freedom controls and the bundled certificate.
The deformation interface: one shared native Spin-side source, the closure observable and its anti-vacuity controls; the earlier 'S^1 x R^3' wording for the control base was corrected here.
notes: The wording correction is a documentation event, not a change of any theorem.

description: The fixed-base smoke test: outcome C. The tested knob is universally admissible and pure gauge on the control, with no parameter dependence of the induced tangent metric along the explicit branch.

Intermediate closure. Two small strengthenings were added (smoothness of the projected Lorentz gauge; transport of arbitrary regular solder solutions with preservation of the induced metric), the milestone certificate and the axiom audit were created, and the documentation snapshot in docs/ was generated and validated.
notes: No theorem statement of Tasks 36-38 was changed by Task 39.

description: The originally drafted next step (a connection/parallel-transport gate) was NOT implemented: the present phase closes below that layer. The draft specification is retained as a handoff document.
notes: Retained unchanged so that the next phase can start from it.

description: Task 40 release hardening: the Task-38 result was rescoped everywhere, the false 'no Lie algebra' statements were removed and the existing intrinsic Lorentz-skew Lie-algebra layer was registered, the type-incorrect 'spinCover composed with a connection one-form' wording was withdrawn, the PROJECT_STATE taxonomy and the solder gate classification were repaired, the registry declaration kinds were made explicit, and the Task-39 module count was corrected from three to four.
notes: No theorem statement, hypothesis or mathematical construction was changed; the only Lean edit was audit-only.

description: Task 40 completed as a historical task; a post-release review then found four snapshot defects, repaired by Task 41: (1) release documentation had reintroduced the obsolete Task-35 causal explanation that a strong smooth Lorentz bundle equivalence is blocked because the native Spin cocycle is only continuous, replaced by the source-supported distinction (certified smooth projected Lorentz data; infrastructure/packaging limitation); (2) CLAIM-S010 listed the definitions THM-S017 and THM-S018 inside supporting_theorem_ids, now restricted to THM-S019, THM-S020, THM-S021 with the definitions moved to the new optional supporting_construction_ids; (3) the statement extractor truncated THM-G004 at a haveI := inside its result type, now repaired with a regression test and explicit statement_extraction_status; (4) the Task-37/38 cle-0 one-parameter family is classified as a selected control direction (canonical_status SELECTED_CONTROL, exhaustive false) rather than an ordinary canonical derived local structure.
notes: No theorem statement, hypothesis or mathematical construction was changed; no Lean source file was modified. Task-40 history was not rewritten.
